METHODOLOGY: the extract gates are decided on samples too small for one live run to resolve. relations n=27 means a single item moves precision 3.6 points; the same byte-identical prompt scored 0.92 and 0.857 on two runs. Until gate runs are repeated (median of N) or the corpus grows, only large regressions are detectable and near-threshold results must not be read as signal. DECISIONS I20.
